tagging_basis: Eduqas C720QS Version 4 prescribed texts and the 2027 Poetry Anthology (owner route)

units.summary: An Inspector Calls: Write about Mr Arthur Birling in An Inspector Calls and how he is important to the play as a whole.
units.difficulty_basis: 40-mark essay using an extract and the whole play (35 + 5 SPaG)

units.summary: A Christmas Carol: Scrooge’s thoughts and feelings about Christmas change. Write about how Dickens presents this at different points in the novel.
units.difficulty_basis: 40-mark essay using an extract and the whole novel, with context (AO3)

units.summary: Unseen poetry: Write about the poem The Newcomer by Brian Patten, and its effect on you.
Unseen poetry comparison: Now compare The Fish Are All Sick by Anne Stevenson, and The Newcomer by Brian Patten.
